gates.rule: abs(actual-reference) <= abs + rel*abs(reference); all values, no percentile pass

referenceBackend.weights: independent scalar IEEE binary16 decoder and scalar E4M3FN table, each FP8 own scalar F32 scale, decoded F32 bytes hashed
referenceBackend.linear: NumPy binary64 matrix multiply; explicit F32 output then separate F32 bias add
referenceBackend.norm: binary64 population variance/mean or RMS reduction, epsilon1e-6; explicit F32 output
referenceBackend.gelu: binary64 tanh GELU exact documented formula, explicit F32 output
referenceBackend.attention: all40 heads, each Q2 x actual L keys, binary64 scaled score/stable softmax/context, explicit F32 context output; no mask/dropout/RoPE
referenceBackend.pointwise: separate binary32 add/multiply; no fused addcmul

parameterProof.scope: All29 runtime parameter selections including chunk-specific time/modulation reads. Numerical output gates remain separate. Unpatched baseline proves exact independent original decoder bytes.
